newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Lion Land unit in China venture.
newsitem.headline: Lion Land unit in China venture.

text.p: Lion Land Bhd said on Tuesday that its 51 percent owned unit Lion Biotech Pte Ltd proposes to enter into a traditional medicine joint venture in China.

The proposed joint-venture partners are Hua De Chang Trading Co Ltd at three percent and Beijing Zhuajia Science R & D Co Ltd at two percent, with Lion Biotech holding a 95 percent stake, Lion Land said in a statement.
The joint venture, known as Zhuhai Lion International Biotech Co Ltd, is formed for research and development as well as investment in Chinese traditional medicine.
Lion Land said the total proposed paid-up capital of the venture is $1.27 million, and Lion Biotech's investment cost will be $1.21 million.
Lion Biotech's investment will financed by internal resouces and bank borrowings. Lion Biotech is already a shareholder in three joint-venture firms in China involved in pharmaceutical products.
Lion Land is involved in property development, making wire rods and reinforced bars and other products.
